EU ID circuits (register_id, vc_and_disclose_id, disclose_id), all OFAC circuits, SMT non-inclusion (utils/crypto/merkle-trees/smt.circom), V2 contracts; at 4f18c75
Aadhaar circuits (REGISTER_AADHAAR, VC_AND_DISCLOSE_Aadhaar, pack.circom) at 3905a30a and FpPowGenericMod at 145cc894

BattleTested.evidence: Self (ex-OpenPassport) app in production on Celo mainnet; the official @selfxyz/contracts README lists per-circuit Groth16 verifiers, e.g. Verifier_dsc_sha256_rsa_65537_4096 at 0x711e655c43410fB985c4EDB48E9bCBdDb770368d, which has code on Celo mainnet (eth_getCode via forno.celo.org).

source.CommitNote: Squash-merge 'Feat/aadhaar (#949)' on main, same day as the third zkSecurity report (2025-09-09). The repo has no git tags/releases. It postdates the Jan-2025 audit fixes (PRs #331/#354/#358/#360 etc.) and the June-2025 fixes ('Circuit audit fixes (#644)' 22681b1f, 8801c6c, 49de549), and contains the Aadhaar fixes for #00 (AssertBytes in CountryNotInList), #02 (Num2Bits(7) on minimumAge) and #05 (dummy constraint removed). The individual Aadhaar fix commits cited in the report (60501d1, 285f0a9, ...) were squashed and do not exist in the history; Aadhaar circuit files are untouched on main after this commit.
